game: CAR @ GB Week 9 2025, kickoff 2025-11-02 13:00 ET, Lambeau outdoors, GB -12.5, total 43.5, moneylines not in pack, weather forecast not saved

script.base: Book has GB leading a moderate-scoring game (implied GB 28.0 / CAR 15.5 on a 43.5 total). GB should be ahead by halftime, throw enough early through Love to Doubs and Kraft to get to 28, then lean the run late with Jacobs. Carolina, with Dalton questionable (thumb) and center Cade Mays already out, struggles to stay on schedule; once behind they throw more, but this is not a shootout.
script.flip1: GB is up big early, kills the clock, and Love/Doubs/Kraft yardage stalls after the lead is built while Emanuel Wilson steals late carries from Jacobs. Carolina garbage-time passes add McMillan/Legette targets without efficiency against a GB defense that has allowed only 13 passes of 20+ in 7 games.
script.flip2: Carolina hangs around (Dalton plays through the thumb, GB offense stalls) so the lead never becomes a clock-kill. Jacobs/Wilson rush volume disappoints, both passing games stay modest, and the game drifts under 43.5.

matchup.pressure: Neither side is a high-blitz team (GB 22%, CAR 24%). CAR's banged-up OL (Mays out, three other OL questionable) is the pressure risk, and it hits Carolina's own deep shots, not GB's skill players. GB missing Van Ness is a small pass-rush downgrade the other way.
matchup.bleeds: CAR bleeds the middle (9.71 YPA on 49 attempts) and the run (4.81 YPC, 20 runs of 10+ in 8 games). CAR's right side is their best pass zone (5.44 YPA) vs left 6.79. GB does not bleed the run (3.76 YPC, only 10 runs of 10+ in 7 games). GB's softest pass zone is the middle (6.83 YPA) vs left 5.34 and right 5.89, with just 13 passes of 20+ for 291 yards in 7 games.
matchup.overlap: The clean overlap is Tucker Kraft into CAR's middle. Weeks 6-8 he had 21 targets, 244 yards and only 77 air yards — a YAC/middle TE, not a vertical shot — exactly where CAR allows 9.71 YPA, with Umanmielen out and Wallace questionable. Doubs is the air-yards piece (321 air on 23 targets) into a less clear weakness. Dowdle's carry spike does not overlap a GB run-defense weakness.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Kraft under 56.5 lost the ticket. The most likely reason is that 143 yards was one explosive YAC day, and his other recent games (56, 43, 58) are a coin flip at 56.5. GB led by three scores early, Love handed it to Jacobs and then Wilson, and Kraft's routes dried up after two quarters. Carolina also could have taken the seam away with a shell we never charted, funneling the 28 points through Jacobs on the ground (CAR allows 4.81 YPC) and Doubs outside. Dalton's thumb and Mays being out do not hurt this leg; a GB pass-stall or a TE takeaway does. Weather was never saved, so a surprise wind/rain game that turned it into a pure run slog would have killed it and we would not have seen it coming.
slip_story: One story only: GB's offense against Carolina's two leaks, but only the middle/TE leak is clean enough to card. Kraft recyds over belongs to a GB-controls stack (they score their 28 through the seam, then run). It does not belong with a game under, with Dowdle rush over (needs Carolina to stay on schedule vs a 3.76 YPC defense), or with Jacobs rush over in the same slip while his form and the Wilson snap split are unresolved. A blowout flip helps Wilson rushyds over 21.5 (L3 20 car/89 yds, last4 44, 11, 17, 61 vs a 21.5 median) and hurts Kraft, so Wilson is noted and not paired. No prices, so no slip is playable.
